name: Ranger Deadeye extends Auto Shot as well as the Ranger's ranged abilities by 5 yds (#1733)
contract: Deadeye 300700 (Ranger Archery talent, CharacterAdvancement 29447, SpellFamilyName 27) reads 'Increases the range of your ranged abilities and Auto Shot by $s1 yds.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with MiscValue 5 = SPELLMOD_RANGE and BasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = +5, masked to family 27 words (1081480, 210305041, 18882688), which covers the Ranger's shots such as Quick Shot 500074 (family 27, flags 0/1/0, SpellRange 54 = 30 yds). The Auto Shot every Ranger learns at level 1 (AscensionCustomClassData {21, 1, 75}) is spell 75, SpellFamilyName 9 with flags (1, 0, 0) and SpellRange 114 = 35 yds, so the family-27 mask can never select it and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod leaves it at 35 yds. The tooltip names Auto Shot explicitly, so with Deadeye learned Auto Shot must reach 35 + 5 = 40 yds, Quick Shot 30 + 5 = 35 yds, and the melee Flank 804940 (SpellRange 2 = 5 yds, outside the mask) must stay unchanged. spell_max_range is SpellInfo::GetMaxRange with the player's SPELLMOD_RANGE modifiers, the same Player::ApplySpellMod call Spell::CheckRange makes. Before the fix the Auto Shot assertion reads +0.

steps.label: SETUP: Auto Shot starts at its native 35 yds
SETUP: Deadeye is active on the Ranger
CONTROL: Quick Shot's range rises by 5 yds
DISCRIMINATING: Auto Shot's range rises by 5 yds
REGRESSION: the melee Flank keeps its range
Unlearning Deadeye returns Auto Shot to 35 yds
